title: David Price
body: David Price is an architect and planner who collaborated with his older brother Cedric Price as a consultant over the course of three decades, beginning in 1971. Most notably David Price contributed models, under the pseudonym “J. Petto,” to such projects as Munich Olympic Village (1971), Blackpool Zoo Restaurant (1971-73), Southend Roof (1972), Parc de la Villette (1982-83), and the IFCCA Prize Competition for the West Side of Manhattan (1998-99).
